name: Alchemy
tagline: Blockchain developer platform with node APIs, NFT data, and web3 infrastructure
description: Alchemy is a blockchain developer platform providing node infrastructure, enhanced APIs, NFT and token data, webhooks, and developer tools across major EVM chains and others. Developers authenticate with an API key embedded in the HTTPS endpoint path (or via header on some products), call JSON-RPC methods and Alchemy-enhanced APIs, and build wallets, dapps, and indexers without running their own nodes.

auth.details: API key via URL path (https://{network}.g.alchemy.com/v2/YOUR_API_KEY) or Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY; self-serve dashboard signup

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free tier includes 30 million compute units (CUs) per month; exact CU and rate limits vary by plan — confirm on pricing page
pricing.paid_plans: Pay As You Go and Enterprise plans based on compute units

rate_limits: Plan-dependent; Free ~25 RPS / 500 CU/s; Pay As You Go ~300 RPS / 10,000 CU/s (confirm current published limits)
use_cases: get latest Ethereum block number via JSON-RPC
fetch NFT metadata and ownership for a wallet
send eth_call or getTransactionReceipt without running a node
